catalog.title: Material catalogue
catalog.text: An open catalogue of 3D printing filaments: brands, lines, colours and properties. No sign-up needed.

presets.title: Print presets
presets.text: Ready settings for a specific filament and printer: from the manufacturer, from the community, and your own. Anyone can view them; saving and editing needs an account.
presets.action: How a preset reaches the slicer

orca.title: OrcaSlicer plugin
orca.text: FilamentHub opens inside the official OrcaSlicer: the catalogue, presets and your spools next to slicing. The plugin installs from Plugin Hub.

spools.title: Spool tracking
spools.text: Your shelf: which spools you have, how much is left on each and what the filament cost. Needs an account; basic tracking is free.

printers.title: Printers and usage tracking
printers.text: Your printers, feed systems and spools in slots; usage is deducted from the spool after a print. What is reported automatically depends on how the printer is connected.

edge.title: FH Edge
edge.text: Edge is a small node on your network that links printers to FilamentHub with no open slicer and no manufacturer cloud. Currently in alpha.

production.title: Costing and orders
production.text: Print cost from G-code, a quote for the client and order tracking. Available to every account.

labels.title: Labels and QR
labels.text: A QR label for every spool: a scan opens its card on any device.
labels.action: Why a spool needs a QR

learning.title: Knowledge base
learning.text: Guides on materials, print settings and working with the service. Open to everyone.

brands.title: For manufacturers
brands.text: A verified brand page, official materials and presets, QR codes for packaging. Needs a brand representative account.

items.catalog-search: Material catalogue with search by brand, type, colour and properties, with market data for your country
items.catalog-card: Material card: composition, properties, packaging options and data-sheet values with their source
items.brand-cabinet: Brand pages and a manufacturer cabinet: product lines, colour palettes, availability, CSV import
items.presets: Print presets: official, community and your own, with version history and settings editing
items.orca-plugin: Plugin for the official OrcaSlicer from Plugin Hub: the catalogue and your spools inside the slicer. On OrcaSlicer 2.5 a preset appears in the list without a restart, and one you save in the slicer goes to your account by itself
items.spools: Spool tracking: remaining weight, price, batch and consumption history; Spoolman-compatible, bring your stock over from a spreadsheet or OctoPrint SpoolManager
items.spool-shelf: Shelf grouped by manufacturer or type, personal folders and low-stock alerts
items.spending: Spending summary: what the filament on your shelf costs and what orders bring in
items.usage: Usage tracked automatically: Bambu Lab over the local network without the cloud, Happy Hare in place of Spoolman, OctoPrint through the Bridge plugin
items.printers: Your printers with local network discovery, feed systems and spool assignments to slots; automatic data exchange depends on the connection
items.calc: Production costing from G-code or from an OrcaSlicer slice: cost on the right machine, including multi-plate projects
items.quotes: Quotations with a PDF and a link for the client, orders and a CRM workspace
items.labels: Your own QR labels for spools: size, fields and saved layouts; QR scanning right in the browser
items.learning: Achievements, guides in the Wiki, and the interface in Russian, English and Chinese
items.edge-bridge: Edge: a direct link between the printer and FilamentHub with no open OrcaSlicer and no manufacturer cloud, including Bambu Lab without Bambu Cloud. The program for Linux and Docker is in alpha
items.edge-tags: Edge tag station: reads and writes NFC tags on spools; built from off-the-shelf boards, currently a prototype
items.weight: Filament tracking by weight, not only by estimate: weigh-ins and empty-spool weight
items.feeders-easy: Happy Hare and OctoPrint connection in a few steps
items.feeders-more: QIDI Box and Flashforge printers: slots and usage
items.diagnostics: Troubleshooting failed prints: your slice and a photo give you the settings worth suspecting and what to try first
items.matching: Preset suggestions for your printer that explain why they fit
items.orca-hints: Hints right inside OrcaSlicer: “not enough filament on this spool” and a spool panel next to filament selection
items.edge-scales: Spool scales as part of Edge

featuresPage.seoDescription: What FilamentHub does: a filament catalogue, presets for OrcaSlicer, spool tracking, automatic usage tracking from printers, print costing and tools for manufacturers.
featuresPage.title: What FilamentHub does
featuresPage.lead: FilamentHub is a service for people who 3D print: a filament catalogue with print settings, tracking for your own spools and costing for orders. The catalogue and the knowledge base are open without sign-up; everything else needs an account.
featuresPage.aboutText: Plans and work in progress are listed on the About page.

forBrands.seoDescription: FilamentHub for filament manufacturers: a verified brand page, exact material cards, official presets for OrcaSlicer and QR codes for packaging.
forBrands.title: For filament manufacturers
forBrands.lead: Your buyers set up their prints in OrcaSlicer. FilamentHub opens right inside it, and your filament appears there with your settings instead of guesses from chat groups.

steps.representation: Apply for the brand or for its representation in your country. After verification the brand is marked as official.
steps.profile: Fill in the shared brand page and the details of your market.
steps.materials: Describe exact product variants: lines, colours, packaging. The catalogue can be imported from CSV.
steps.presets: Link official print settings to materials. Buyers get them in the catalogue and in OrcaSlicer.
steps.qr: Prepare QR codes for boxes and spools. A scan opens the material card and its presets.
steps.insights: Invite your team and country representatives, reply to reviews and see the statistics.

forBrands.startText: Create an account, switch your profile to company mode and claim your brand. If the brand is not in the catalogue yet, send a request to create it. Once approved, it appears in your cabinet.
forBrands.contactText: Questions about representation and working together:

rows.now: A buyer looks for settings for your filament on forums and in chats
rows.with: Your official preset sits on the material card, marked as the manufacturer's

rows.now: Settings from a website or a PDF are copied into the slicer by hand, with mistakes
rows.with: The preset is imported into OrcaSlicer in one click, from inside the slicer

rows.now: The box leads nowhere: it has no path to print settings
rows.with: A QR code on the box or the spool opens that material's card and its presets

rows.now: Reviews of printing with your filament are scattered across marketplaces
rows.with: Ratings and print reviews are gathered on the material page

rows.now: Every country has its own prices and stock, and there is one page for all
rows.with: A country representative keeps the prices and stock of their market; the shared details stay with you

forBrands.figureAlt: A brand page in the FilamentHub catalogue: the official manufacturer mark and a list of materials with colours
forBrands.figureCaption: A verified brand page: the official manufacturer mark, materials with colours and a QR code for each. The brand in the picture is fictional. The description, links and shops are the ones the manufacturer set for the reader's country.
forBrands.stepsLead: Six steps. Each has a guide.

tags.title: Tags on the packaging
tags.lead: From a QR sticker to an NFC tag on the spool: as far as you need to go.

qr.title: A QR code on the box or the spool
qr.text: We issue a QR code for every material, in batches. Printing it on the label is enough: a scan from a phone opens the material card and your preset.

open.title: Your NFC tags in open formats
open.text: If you already put TigerTag, OpenSpool or OpenPrintTag tags on your spools, FilamentHub reads their contents and finds your material in the catalogue by them. Our own reading device, FH Edge, is still a prototype.

write.title: An NFC tag instead of a sticker
write.text: For premium packaging. The FH Edge station already writes tags for users' spools; writing tags for a manufacturer's materials is planned.

demo.banner: This is a demo with sample data. Changes are not saved.
